MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Standing Ovation feels like a natural next choice because I want the expressive stage songs that drew me to Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Dark Sky Island fits my quieter listening mood after relaxing classical music, while Nobody but Me and Classic Sinatra appeal to my interest in polished, melodic vocals."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Book of Mormon shares a stage connection, but explicit comedy does not give me the soothing, melodic singing I want now.",
    "The Adele albums and Leonard Cohen collection offer vocal music, but their styles feel less suited to my current preference for theatrical singing and gentle orchestration.",
    "I cannot judge 16 Most Requested Songs from its title alone, so I lack a clear musical reason to choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Several choices seem to assume that enjoying vocal albums means I want any prominent singer, when the vocal style and mood matter more to me.",
    "The stage connection seems too broad when it includes comedy musicals alongside the expressive stage-song performances I am seeking."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My interest in Stages and A Musical Affair points toward soaring, melodic performances rather than just songs with vocals.",
    "My most recent relaxing classical selection makes atmosphere and gentle accompaniment especially relevant to what I would choose now.",
    "Offering three Adele albums gives too much weight to a style I am not seeking on this visit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in melodic vocals, but missed how strongly stage-song expression and a relaxing mood guide my choices right now."
}
